senses.gloss: f.(b. h.;יעב , Barth Et. St. p. 28; cmp., however, עֲבָבִית, עַוִּית) that which is repulsive, abomination.
units: <cite ref="Proverbs 28:9">Prov. XXVIII, 9</cite>) his prayer is an abomination (unacceptable).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 27:7">Lev. R. s. 27</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 41:24">Is. XLI, 24</cite>) <he>אותה ת׳ שכתוב בה … מאותה הת׳ וכ׳</he> that abomination of which it is said (<cite ref="Exodus 32:8">Ex. XXXII, 8</cite>) ‘they have made themselves a molten image’—of that abomination (that class of animals) bring ye an offering &c.; Tanḥ. Emor 11.

<cite ref="Niddah 70a:1">Nidd. 70ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yevamot 11b:11">Yeb. 11ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 24:4">Deut. XXIV, 4</cite>) <he>היא ת׳ ואין בניה תּוֹעֵבִין</he> she (the divorced woman remarried after having been another man’s wife) is an abomination, but her children are not abominations (her daughters may be married by priests); <cite ref="Kiddushin 77a:13">Kidd. 77ᵃ</cite> <he>תּוֹעֵבִים</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 4:13:2">Y. Yeb. IV, 6ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>היא ת׳ ואין הוולד ת׳</he>.
